g.text: Section cut (real wall, continues to an excluded point)
(wall end) = confirmed dead end in the original source, not a cut
Lighting key – all 2700K, CRI 90+, LED-rated dimmers
Z1 Main + walkway: 8 recessed 4" wafer (one at the walkway/trophy junction), 2700K, CRI 90+
Z2 East zone: 1 recessed for prayer space + dining route (walkway light, shelf strips and gimbals cover the rest)
Z3 Accents: 3 photo-wall gimbals + 2 fireplace grazers
Z4 Mandir: spot aimed at idols + alcove strip + jali backlight
Z5 Library + trophy: LED strips in aluminium channels
Z6 Screen-wall backlight (dim bias light for movies)
◯× recessed downlight ◯•→ adjustable gimbal (aim shown) - - - LED strip ■ keypad (K1 at hallway, K2 by dining/master)
Scenes: Movie (Z6 10%, Z5 5%, rest off) · Evening (Z1 40%, Z3-Z5 on) · Puja (Z4 100%, Z2 30%) · Bright (all 100%)
Keep lights 2 ft+ from the screen wall · grazers 6–12" from the stone · gimbals ~2 ft from the photo wall, aimed ~30°
